breakdown.note: Associate General Manager + Senior Program Manager titles map well to this strategic operator role; P&L ownership and 60+ team leadership demonstrate required seniority. No gap on 8+ years or program ownership.

EdTech SaaS is not enterprise software or AI/platform; however, D2C and multi-market expansion show scalability mindset. AI/GEO research and current MBA in Digital Technology provide modern AI exposure, but no prior enterprise SaaS, platform, or large B2B GTM operations background.

Concrete outcomes: 38% CAC lift, 19% revenue growth, 42% sales productivity gains, 25% sales growth from positioning redesign. Strong on execution and metrics. Launch experience and operating model/governance building less articulated; mostly tactical program wins rather than scaling operating rhythms.

top_signal: 8+ years of progressive GTM and operations leadership (Associate Program Manager → AGM) with documented ability to redesign cross-functional execution, build systems (CRM scoring, dashboards, onboarding), and drive measurable business impact (38% CAC lift, 25% sales growth, 42% productivity gain); plus current hands-on research into AI visibility (GEO), which aligns with OpenAI's mission.

EdTech D2C background is transferable but not enterprise-grade SaaS or platform GTM depth.
